name: The Tome of Divinity

meta.previous: Tome of Divinity (Azar Stronghammer) / Tome of Divinity (Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker) / Tome of Divinity (Brandur Ironhammer)

summary: The Tome of Divinity marks an essential milestone in a dwarven paladin's training within Ironforge. Bestowed by Tiza Battleforge in the Hall of Mysteries, this holy text begins a trials-based journey meant to test an initiate's devotion to the Light and their readiness to defend Azeroth against dark forces like the Scourge.

sections.title: A Calling to Virtue
sections.body: Paladin mentors across the eastern kingdoms direct promising initiates to Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries once they demonstrate mastery of martial and spiritual fundamentals. Under the watchful eye of High Priestess Tiza Battleforge, young dwarven paladins are introduced to the solemn principles that separate a simple warrior from an ordained champion of the Holy Light. Taking up this task represents a conscious pledge toward lifelong self-sacrifice, duty, and spiritual discipline.

sections.title: The Book of Divinity
sections.body: Accepting this charge places a Book of Divinity into the hands of the novice. This text outlines the expectations, virtues, and spiritual tenets required to wield sacred energies effectively against wicked threats. Studying its teachings is merely the introductory step; the scripture serves as a foundational guide before the initiate is sent forth across Khaz Modan and beyond to embody its lessons in real acts of faith.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Tome of Divinity quest?
aliases: what does tome of divinity do
faq.answer: This quest is the doorway to advanced paladin training for dwarven champions. By speaking with Tiza Battleforge, initiates receive their holy text and embark on a series of trials designed to prove their virtue and unlock the ability to call fallen allies back from death.

aliases: who is the paladin trainer in ironforge
faq.answer: Tiza Battleforge is a prominent paladin trainer residing in the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge. She is tasked with guiding dwarven paladins toward greater virtue, testing their devotion to the Light, and preparing them to confront threats such as the Scourge.

faq.q: Why must initiates study the Book of Divinity?
aliases: what is the book of divinity
faq.answer: The Book of Divinity contains core teachings regarding the duties and virtues demanded by the Holy Light. Studying it ensures that an initiate understands the spiritual discipline required before wielding miraculous sacred powers.

faq.q: What major threats are dwarven paladins preparing to fight?
faq.answer: As outlined by Tiza Battleforge, the paladins dedicate themselves to defending Azeroth from dangerous perils across the land, with particular vigilance directed toward the encroaching undead menace of the Scourge.

faq.q: Where does this training take place?
faq.answer: The initiation begins in the Hall of Mysteries, the quiet sanctuary nestled in the northern quarters of Ironforge where scholars, priests, mages, and paladins gather in prayer and study.

faq.q: What comes next after receiving the book?
aliases: where do i go after getting the book
faq.answer: Once the initiate reads and contemplates the Book of Divinity, Tiza Battleforge delivers practical trials that require the paladin to demonstrate compassion, duty, and sacrifice outside the safety of the city gates.

angles.text: This rite of passage bridges early martial instruction with the deeper virtues of the Holy Light, setting initiates on the path to channel the power of redemption and resurrection.
For dwarven champions, taking the Tome of Divinity reinforces the alliance of faith forged between the Bronzebeard kingdom and the human knights of the Silver Hand.
